title: Adjacency Signal Roster & Effort Draft
content:
Quick summary:
This is a light, one-page roster mapping likely cross-team signals (latent ops hits, cost spikes, customer escalations) to primary + backup owners and rough effort assumptions. Purpose: 1) give on-call/rotation leads a short lookup during a week-long experiment (regional fallback + canary burst); 2) estimate small reserve staffing for product-ops to coordinate.

Scope / how to use:
- Narrow: signals we expect while rolling canary fallback variants across EU region over 48h.
- Rows are prioritized (P0..P3). Use phone/Slack first, escalate to the listed backup if no ack in 20m.
- Effort estimates assume first responder will TTR to mitigation then hand off for followups.

Legend: P0 = page now; P1 = respond within 30m; P2 = next-business-hour; P3 = monitor.

Table (columns): Signal | Priority | Primary owner | Backup owner | Est. first-response hours | Typical follow-up hrs | Linked ticket / play 
---
Latency spike (token p99 > 3s) | P0 | Jordan Liu (eng-sre) | Arjun Rao (platform-eng) | 1.0 | 2-4 | JIRA-4202 / latency playbook
Model quality regression (eval drift > 3pts) | P0 | Evelyn Park (applied-ml) | Maya Chen (product-ops) | 0.5 | 4-8 | CONFLUENCE:Eval-Runbook
Embedding cost surge (2x cost week-on-week) | P1 | Samir Patel (observability) | Tina Morales (finance) | 0.5 | 2-6 | JIRA-4310
KV cache pressure (miss rate > 30%) | P1 | Nikhil Desai (serving-runtime) | Jordan Liu (eng-sre) | 1.0 | 3-6 | internal-run:kv-cache
Regional capacity throttle (EU burst failover) | P0 | Priya Kapoor (platform-eng) | Samir Patel (observability) | 0.5 | 2-6 | JIRA-4401
Fallback model mismatch (user sees different tone) | P2 | Maya Chen (product-ops) | Evelyn Park (applied-ml) | 0.5 | 1-3 | PLAYBOOK:fallback-checklist
Quota/limits breach (account-level) | P0 | Support Rotation (customer-success) | Tina Morales (finance) | 0.5 | 1-3 | JIRA-4455
Billing spike / invoice dispute | P1 | Tina Morales (finance) | Support Rotation (customer-success) | 0.5 | 4-8 | billing/INV-998
Telemetry ingestion lag (missing events) | P1 | Samir Patel (observability) | Nikhil Desai (serving-runtime) | 0.5 | 2-4 | internal:telemetry-lag
Degraded function calling (tools/errors) | P0 | Jordan Liu (eng-sre) | Maya Chen (product-ops) | 0.5 | 3-5 | JIRA-4522
Eval alert (new prompts failing smoke) | P1 | Evelyn Park (applied-ml) | Arjun Rao (platform-eng) | 0.5 | 2-6 | CONFLUENCE:eval-alerts
Customer escalation: SLA impact | P0 | Support Rotation (customer-success) | Priya Kapoor (platform-eng) | 0.5 | 8+ | CUSTOMER-CASE-1234
Minor docs mismatch (help center) | P3 | Maya Chen (product-ops) | Support Rotation (customer-success) | 0.25 | 1-2 | docs:help-center-update

Effort assumptions (quick):
- First responder handles triage + short mitigation: 0.5-1.0h typical for P0/P1; 0.25-0.5h for P2/P3.
- Follow-up work (post-mortem, fixes) is separate and logged to a ticket; estimate per-event follow-ups 1-8h depending on scope.
- If more than 3 concurrent P0 signals in 2h window, request immediate capacity from platform on-call (escalate to Eng Director).

Quick pivot: expected resourcing for 48h canary window (conservative):
- 1 product-ops lead (Maya) 8h/day = coordination & comms
- 1 eng-sre primary + 1 backup (Jordan + Arjun) = handling lat/infra issues
- 1 applied-ml for regression checks (Evelyn) = 4h/day spread
- Observability + finance on-call waves (Samir + Tina) = ad-hoc 2-4h/day each

Open questions / unknowns (notes to self):
- Do we have a pre-created canned message for customers on EU partial degradation? (action: Maya to draft)
- Which exact KV cache metrics are on the telemetry dashboard (need paths)? Samir to confirm link.
- Confirm escalation chain for billing disputes across APAC customers — separate doc?

Next steps / immediate actions:
- [ ] Maya: publish this roster to the rolling canary channel and pin (by EOD 2026-07-09)
- [ ] Evelyn: create a short eval smoke job with baseline prompts and add to alerts (by 2026-07-10)
- [ ] Samir: validate telemetry dashboard links and add short links column (by 2026-07-10)
- [ ] Jordan: confirm runbook play links (latency / traffic shaping) and test page path (by 2026-07-11)

Freeform / scraps (raw):
- quick note: if fallback model is quantized variant, audible tone drift reported yesterday in @customer-sample -> flag for re-eval.
- message template draft: "We're investigating elevated latency in EU; your requests may be rerouted — we'll update in <2h>."

If merged into a formal ops deck later: add a short SLA-impact table and list of phone numbers for P0 paging.

End of draft.
